definitions.explanation: the act of tasting drinks, especially wine, sake, or other beverages, before purchasing

examples.japanese: ワインの{試飲|しいん}ができます。
{試飲|しいん}コーナーで{新商品|しんしょうひん}を{試|ため}した。
examples.english: I tried the new product at the tasting counter.

examples.japanese: {酒蔵|さかぐら}{見学|けんがく}で{日本酒|にほんしゅ}の{試飲|しいん}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: I enjoyed sake tasting during the brewery tour.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
- {試|し} (trial, test)
- {飲|いん} (drinking)

VERB USAGE:
- {試飲|しいん}する (to taste/sample a drink)
- {試飲|しいん}できる (able to taste)

RELATED TERMS:
- {試食|ししょく} (food tasting/sampling)
- {利|き}き{酒|ざけ} (sake tasting, specifically for comparing flavors)
- テイスティング (tasting - loanword)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {酒蔵|さかぐら}・ワイナリー (breweries/wineries)
- スーパー・デパートの{試飲|しいん}コーナー (supermarket/department store tasting corners)
